blocks.text_en: 1. Introduction
blocks.text_zh: 1. 引言

blocks.text_en: This chapter provides an introduction to the guidance provided in the TOGAF Standard — EA Capability and Governance (this document).
blocks.text_zh: 本章介绍《TOGAF标准——EA能力与治理》（本文档）提供的指导。

blocks.text_en:
In order to successfully operate an architecture function within an
enterprise, it is necessary to put in place appropriate organization
structures, processes, roles, responsibilities, and governance.
blocks.text_zh: 要在企业中成功运行架构职能，必须建立适当的组织结构、过程、角色、职责和治理。

blocks.text_en: Guidelines included within this document are as follows:
blocks.text_zh: 本文档包含下列指导：

blocks.text_en: Establishing an Architecture Capability (see Chapter 2, Establishing an Architecture Capability ) provides guidelines on how to use the ADM to establish an Architecture Capability Architecture Governance (see Chapter 3, Architecture Governance ) provides a framework and guidelines for Architecture Governance Architecture Board (see Chapter 4, Architecture Board ) provides guidelines for establishing and operating an Enterprise Architecture Board Architecture Contracts (see Chapter 5, Architecture Contracts ) provides guidelines for defining and using Architecture Contracts Architecture Compliance (see Chapter 6, Architecture Compliance ) provides guidelines for ensuring project compliance to the architecture
blocks.text_zh:
- 建立架构能力（第2章）：指导如何运用ADM建立架构能力。
- 架构治理（第3章）：提供架构治理框架和指导。
- 架构委员会（第4章）：指导如何建立和运行企业架构委员会。
- 架构契约（第5章）：指导如何定义和使用架构契约。
- 架构符合性（第6章）：指导如何确保项目符合架构。

blocks.text_en: 2. Establishing an Architecture Capability
blocks.text_zh: 2. 建立架构能力

blocks.text_en:
This chapter provides guidelines on how to use the ADM to establish an
Architecture Capability.
blocks.text_zh: 本章指导如何运用ADM建立架构能力。

blocks.text_en: 2.1. Overview

As with any business capability, the establishment of an Enterprise
Architecture Capability can be supported by the TOGAF Architecture
Development Method (ADM). Successful use of the ADM will provide a
customer-focused, value-adding, and sustainable architecture practice
that enables the business, helps maximize the value of investments, and
pro-actively identifies opportunities to gain business benefits and
manage risk.
blocks.text_zh: 与其他业务能力一样，企业架构能力的建立可以得到TOGAF架构开发方法（ADM）的支持。成功应用ADM将形成以客户为中心、增加价值且可持续的架构实践：使能业务、帮助最大化投资价值，并主动识别获取业务收益及管理风险的机会。

blocks.text_en:
Establishing a sustainable architecture practice within an organization
can be achieved by adhering to the same approach that is used to
establish any other capability — such as a Business Process Management
(BPM) capability — within an organization. The ADM is an ideal method to
be used to architect and govern the implementation of such a capability.
Applying the ADM with the specific Architecture Vision to establish an
architecture practice within the organization would achieve this
objective.
blocks.text_zh: 在组织内建立可持续的架构实践，可以遵循建立其他能力（例如业务流程管理BPM能力）的相同方法。ADM是设计此类能力并治理其实施的理想方法。以“在组织内建立架构实践”为特定架构愿景来应用ADM，就能实现这一目标。

blocks.text_en:
The establishment of the architecture practice should not be seen as a
phase of an architecture project, or a one-off project, but rather as an
ongoing discipline that provides the context, environment, and resources
to govern and enable architecture delivery to the organization. As an
architecture project is executed within this environment it might
request a change to the architecture practice that would trigger another
cycle of the ADM to extend the architecture practice.
blocks.text_zh: 不应把建立架构实践看作架构项目中的一个阶段，或一次性项目。它是一项持续的工作纪律，为治理并使能组织的架构交付提供语境、环境和资源。在该环境中执行的架构项目，可能要求改变架构实践，从而触发另一轮ADM以扩展架构实践。

blocks.text_en:
Implementing any capability within an organization would require the
design of the four domain architectures: Business, Data, Application,
and Technology. Establishing the architecture practice within an
organization would therefore require the design of:
blocks.text_zh: 组织实施任何能力都需要设计业务、数据、应用和技术四个领域架构。因此，在组织内建立架构实践需要设计：

blocks.text_en:
The Business Architecture of the architecture practice that will
highlight the Architecture Governance, architecture processes,
architecture organizational structure, architecture information
requirements, architecture products, etc. The Data Architecture that would define the structure of the
organization’s Enterprise Continuum and Architecture Repository The Application Architecture specifying the functionality and/or
applications services required to enable the architecture practice The Technology Architecture that depicts the architecture practice’s
infrastructure requirements and deployment in support of the
architecture applications and Enterprise Continuum
blocks.text_zh:
- 架构实践的业务架构：突出架构治理、架构过程、架构组织结构、架构信息要求、架构产品等。
- 数据架构：定义组织的企业连续体和架构存储库的结构。
- 应用架构：规定使能架构实践所需的功能和/或应用服务。
- 技术架构：描述架构实践的基础设施要求及部署，以支持架构应用和企业连续体。

blocks.text_en:
The steps in establishing an architecture practice are explained below,
against the context of the ADM phases. The reader should therefore refer
to the relevant ADM phase in the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method to understand the complete scope of
each step. In this section, key aspects will be highlighted for each ADM
phase that should be considered and are specific to establishing an
architecture practice. The intent is therefore not to repeat each ADM
phase description, but to guide the reader to apply each ADM phase
within the context of establishing an architecture practice.
blocks.text_zh: 下文在ADM各阶段的语境中解释建立架构实践的步骤。读者应参考《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》的相应阶段，以理解各步骤的完整范围。本节突出各阶段中建立架构实践时特有且应考虑的关键方面；目的不是重复各阶段描述，而是指导在建立架构实践的语境中应用每个阶段。

blocks.text_en: 2.2. Phase A: Architecture Vision
blocks.text_zh: 2.2. A阶段：架构愿景

blocks.text_en:
The purpose of this phase within the context of establishing an
architecture practice is to define or review the vision, stakeholders,
and principles of the architecture practice. The focus in this phase
would be on the architecture practice as a whole and not on a particular
architecture project.
blocks.text_zh: 在建立架构实践的语境中，本阶段旨在定义或复核架构实践的愿景、利益相关者和原则。本阶段关注整个架构实践，而非某个具体架构项目。

blocks.text_en:
The following should be considered in terms of understanding the steps
in the context of establishing an architecture practice:
blocks.text_zh: 在此语境下理解各步骤时，应考虑：

blocks.text_en:
Establish the Project : this step should focus on performing the necessary procedures to secure recognition of the project, the endorsement of corporate management, and the support and commitment of the necessary line management Include references to other management frameworks in use within the enterprise, explaining how this project relates to those frameworks. Identify Stakeholders and Concerns, Business Requirements, and
Architecture Vision : this step generates the first, very high-level
definitions of the baseline and target environments, from the
perspectives of business information systems and technology, for the
architecture practice Identify Business Goals and Business Drivers : an understanding of the business goals and drivers is essential to align the architecture practice to the business Define Scope : defining the scope of the architecture practice is a high-level project plan of what is scheduled to be addressed in terms of architecture for the next period Define Constraints : the focus in this step is the enterprise-wide constraints that impact on all architecture projects Review Architecture Principles, including Business Principles : the intent in this step is to define the principles that govern and guide the running of the architecture practice Where Architecture Principles usually govern the architecture
deliverables, the architecture practice principles address the
architecture practice organization, content, tools, and process. Develop Statement of Architecture Work and Secure Approval : this
step generates the architecture practice vision and scope
blocks.text_zh:
- **建立项目**：着重履行必要程序，使项目得到认可，获得公司管理层的赞同以及必要业务线管理者的支持和承诺。应引用企业已采用的其他管理框架，说明本项目与这些框架的关系。
- **识别利益相关者与关注点、业务需求及架构愿景**：从业务信息系统和技术的角度，对架构实践的基线与目标环境给出最初的高层定义。
- **识别业务目标和业务驱动因素**：理解这些目标与驱动，是使架构实践与业务对齐的必要条件。
- **定义范围**：架构实践范围的定义，是下一时期计划解决哪些架构事项的高层项目计划。
- **定义约束**：着重识别影响全部架构项目的企业范围约束。
- **复核架构原则，包括业务原则**：旨在定义治理和指导架构实践运行的原则。架构原则通常治理架构交付物，而架构实践原则关注架构实践的组织、内容、工具和过程。
- **制定架构工作说明并获得批准**：本步骤形成架构实践的愿景和范围。

blocks.text_en: Another step that can be considered during this phase is to conduct an architecture maturity assessment. Refer to the TOGAF ® Series Guide: Architecture Maturity Models for guidance on this topic.
blocks.text_zh: 本阶段还可以考虑进行架构成熟度评估，相关指导见《TOGAF系列指南：架构成熟度模型》。

blocks.text_en: 2.3. Phase B: Business Architecture
blocks.text_zh: 2.3. B阶段：业务架构

blocks.text_en:
Key areas of focus during this phase of establishing or refining the
Business Architecture of the architecture practice are:
blocks.text_zh: 在建立或细化架构实践的业务架构时，本阶段的关键关注领域包括：

blocks.text_en:
An Architecture Ontology defining the architectural terms and
definitions that will be used in the organization in order to establish a common understanding of these terms The Architecture Process where the ADM would form the base of the process and need to be customized to meet the organization’s
requirements and architecture practice vision Refer to the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method for guidance on developing this process. The required Architecture Governance processes should be included in the
overall architecture process. The Architecture Viewpoints and Views that list all the viewpoints and views that should be addressed by the architecture practice The identified architecture practice stakeholders would guide the
development of this definition. One of the viewpoints to be included is the Architecture Governance viewpoint; refer to the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Content for guidance on this output. The Architecture Framework describing the various architecture
deliverables that will be generated by the architecture practice, the inter-relationships and dependencies between the architecture
deliverables, as well as the rules and guidelines governing the design of these deliverables The defined architecture viewpoints and views should be used to guide the definition of the architecture framework. The TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method and the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Content are useful references that will assist in describing the architecture framework. The Architecture Accountability Matrix defining the roles in the architecture practice and allocating accountability of the roles to architecture deliverables and processes This matrix would include the required Architecture Governance structures and roles. The TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method as well as Chapter 4, Architecture Board , Chapter 3, Architecture Governance , and
the TOGAF ® Series Guide: Architecture Skills Framework would provide guidance on this output. The Architecture Performance Metrics identifying and describing the metrics that will be used to monitor the performance of the architecture practice against its stated architecture practice vision and objectives The Architecture Governance Framework which is a specific view of the defined architecture process and Architecture Accountability Matrix
blocks.text_zh:
- **架构本体**：定义组织使用的架构术语及其定义，建立共同理解。
- **架构过程**：以ADM为基础，根据组织要求及架构实践愿景进行定制；开发指导见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》。所需的架构治理过程应纳入整体架构过程。
- **架构视点与视图**：列出架构实践应处理的全部视点和视图；由已识别的架构实践利益相关者指导定义。其中应包含架构治理视点，输出指导见《TOGAF标准——架构内容》。
- **架构框架**：描述架构实践将产生的各种交付物、它们之间的关系和依赖，以及治理其设计的规则和指导。已定义的视点与视图应用于指导框架定义；《架构开发方法》和《架构内容》可辅助描述该框架。
- **架构问责矩阵**：定义架构实践中的角色，将角色对架构交付物和过程的问责责任分配清楚；包括所需治理结构和角色。指导见《架构开发方法》、本卷第4章“架构委员会”、第3章“架构治理”及《TOGAF系列指南：架构技能框架》。
- **架构绩效度量**：识别和描述用于按既定愿景与目标监控架构实践绩效的度量。
- **架构治理框架**：是已定义架构过程及架构问责矩阵的一个特定视图。

blocks.text_en: 2.4. Phase C: Data Architecture
blocks.text_zh: 2.4. C阶段：数据架构

blocks.text_en: The Data Architecture of the architecture practice would specify and govern the structure of the organization’s Enterprise Continuum and Architecture Repository. The Data Architecture should be defined based on the architecture framework. The Data Architecture is sometimes referred to as the metamodel of the architecture practice.
blocks.text_zh: 架构实践的数据架构规定并治理组织的企业连续体和架构存储库的结构。应依据架构框架定义该数据架构。有时它也称为架构实践的元模型。

blocks.text_en: 2.5. Phase C: Application Architecture
blocks.text_zh: 2.5. C阶段：应用架构

blocks.text_en:
The Application Architecture of the architecture practice defines the functionality required to generate, maintain, publish, distribute, and govern the architecture deliverables as defined in the architecture framework. A key focus should be on the modeling toolsets required for
modeling, but it should not be the only focus. Refer to the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method for guidance on selecting a toolset. Publishing the architecture
deliverables to address specific views in the architecture framework would sometimes require specialized or customized functionality and should not be neglected.
blocks.text_zh: 架构实践的应用架构定义：为生成、维护、发布、分发和治理架构框架规定的交付物，需要哪些功能。建模工具集应是重点，但不应是唯一重点；选择工具集的指导见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》。为回应框架中特定视图而发布架构交付物，有时需要专用或定制功能，这一点不应忽略。

blocks.text_en: 2.6. Phase D: Technology Architecture
blocks.text_zh: 2.6. D阶段：技术架构

blocks.text_en: The Technology Architecture of the architecture practice should define technology infrastructure supporting the architecture practice.
blocks.text_zh: 架构实践的技术架构应定义支持该实践的技术基础设施。

blocks.text_en: 2.7. Phase E: Opportunities & Solutions
blocks.text_zh: 2.7. E阶段：机会与解决方案

blocks.text_en: A critical factor to consider during this phase of planning the establishment of the architecture practice is the organizational change that is required and how this will be achieved.
blocks.text_zh: 在规划建立架构实践的这一阶段，必须重点考虑所需的组织变革以及怎样实现该变革。

blocks.text_en: 2.8. Phase F: Migration Planning
blocks.text_zh: 2.8. F阶段：迁移规划

blocks.text_en:
The focus should not only be on the Information Systems Architecture components in this phase, but include the Business Architecture. The adoption of the architecture process and framework will have a major impact on the overall establishment of the architecture practice in the
organization.
blocks.text_zh: 本阶段不应只关注信息系统架构组件，也应包括业务架构。架构过程和框架的采用，将显著影响组织内架构实践的整体建立。

blocks.text_en: 2.9. Phase G: Implementation Governance
blocks.text_zh: 2.9. G阶段：实施治理

blocks.text_en:
The implementation of the Business Architecture of the architecture practice should be the focus of this phase. Changing practices within the organization to adopt a more structured and disciplined approach will be a challenge and should be addressed by the appropriate
organizational change techniques.
blocks.text_zh: 本阶段应关注架构实践业务架构的实施。改变组织实践，使其采用更结构化、更有纪律的方法是一项挑战，应运用适当的组织变革技术处理。

blocks.text_en: 2.10. Phase H: Architecture Change Management
blocks.text_zh: 2.10. H阶段：架构变更管理

blocks.text_en:
Changes to the architecture of the architecture practice should be managed by this phase. These changes are usually triggered during the execution of architecture projects. A typical change would be the requirement for a new architecture deliverable. This would impact on all
the architecture domains of the architecture practice.
blocks.text_zh: 本阶段管理架构实践自身架构的变化。这些变化通常由架构项目的执行触发。典型变化是需要一种新的架构交付物，它会影响架构实践的所有领域架构。

blocks.text_en: 2.11. Requirements Management
blocks.text_zh: 2.11. 需求管理

blocks.text_en: Understanding and managing the requirements for the architecture practice is crucial. Requirements should be clearly articulated and align to the architecture practice vision.
blocks.text_zh: 理解和管理架构实践的需求至关重要。需求应清楚表述，并与架构实践愿景对齐。

blocks.text_en: Additional guidance on how to construct an Enterprise Architecture Capability can be found in the TOGAF ® Series Guide: The TOGAF Leader’s Guide to Establishing and Evolving an EA Capability .
blocks.text_zh: 构建企业架构能力的补充指导，见《TOGAF系列指南：TOGAF领导者指南——建立并演进EA能力》。

blocks.text_en: 3. Architecture Governance
blocks.text_zh: 3. 架构治理

blocks.text_en: This chapter provides a framework and guidelines for Architecture Governance.
blocks.text_zh: 本章提供架构治理的框架和指导。

blocks.text_en: 3.1. Introduction

This section describes the nature of governance, and the levels of
governance.
blocks.text_zh: 本节描述治理的性质及治理层次。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.1. Levels of Governance within the Enterprise
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.1. 企业内的治理层次

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Governance is the practice and orientation by which
Enterprise Architectures and other architectures are managed and
controlled at an enterprise-wide level.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理是在企业范围管理和控制企业架构及其他架构的实践与取向。

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Governance typically does not operate in isolation, but
within a hierarchy of governance structures, which, particularly in the
larger enterprise, can include all of the following as distinct domains
with their own disciplines and processes:
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理通常在治理结构的层次体系中运行，而非孤立运行。尤其在大型企业中，下列各项都可能作为具有自身纪律和过程的独立治理领域存在：

blocks.text_en: Corporate Governance Technology Governance IT Governance Architecture Governance
blocks.text_zh:
- 公司治理。
- 技术治理。
- IT治理。
- 架构治理。

blocks.text_en:
Each of these domains of governance may exist at multiple geographic
levels — global, regional, and local — within the overall enterprise.
blocks.text_zh: 在整个企业内，每个治理领域都可能存在于全球、区域和本地等多个地理层次。

blocks.text_en:
Corporate governance is thus a broad topic, beyond the scope of an
Enterprise Architecture framework such as the TOGAF framework.
blocks.text_zh: 因此，公司治理是一个广泛主题，超出了TOGAF这类企业架构框架的范围。

blocks.text_en:
This and related subsections are focused on Architecture Governance; but
they describe it in the context of enterprise-wide governance, because
of the hierarchy of governance structures within which it typically
operates, as explained above.
blocks.text_zh: 本小节及相关小节关注架构治理；由于它通常在前述治理结构层次体系中运行，文中会结合企业整体治理语境进行说明。

blocks.text_en: In particular, this and following sections aim to:
blocks.text_zh: 具体而言，本节及后续各节旨在：

blocks.text_en:
Provide an overview of the nature of governance as a discipline in its
own right Describe the governance context in which Architecture Governance
typically functions within the enterprise Describe a practical Architecture Governance Framework that can be
adapted and applied, both for Enterprise Architecture and for other
forms of IT architecture
blocks.text_zh:
- 概述治理作为独立纪律的性质。
- 描述企业内架构治理通常发挥作用的治理语境。
- 描述一个可以裁剪应用的实用架构治理框架，既可用于企业架构，也可用于其他IT架构。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.2. Nature of Governance
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.2. 治理的性质

blocks.text_en: 3.1.2.1. Governance: A Generic Perspective
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.2.1. 治理的一般视角

blocks.text_en:
Governance is essentially about ensuring that business is conducted
properly. It is less about overt control and strict adherence to rules,
and more about guidance and effective and equitable usage of resources
to ensure sustainability of an organization’s strategic objectives.
blocks.text_zh: 治理的实质是确保业务适当地开展。其重点更多是指导以及有效、公平地使用资源，以确保组织战略目标的可持续性，而较少是显式控制和严格遵守规则。

blocks.text_en:
The following outlines the basic principles of corporate governance, as
identified by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development
(OECD):
blocks.text_zh: 以下概述经济合作与发展组织（OECD）识别的公司治理基本原则：

blocks.text_en:
Focuses on the rights, roles, and equitable treatment of shareholders Disclosure and transparency and the responsibilities of the board Ensures: Sound strategic guidance of the organization Effective monitoring of management by the board Board accountability for the company and to the shareholders Responsibilities of the Board: Reviewing and guiding corporate strategy Setting and monitoring achievement of management’s performance
objectives
blocks.text_zh:
- 关注股东的权利、角色及公平待遇。
- 信息披露、透明度以及董事会的职责。
- 确保对组织的可靠战略指导、董事会对管理层的有效监督，以及董事会对公司和股东承担问责责任。
- 董事会负责复核和指导公司战略，设定管理绩效目标并监控实现情况。

blocks.text_en:
Supporting this, the OECD considers a traditional view of governance as:
“…​ the system by which business corporations are directed and
controlled. The corporate governance structure specifies the
distribution of rights and responsibilities among different participants
in the corporation — such as the board, managers, shareholders, and
other stakeholders — and spells out the rules and procedures for making
decisions on corporate affairs. By doing this, it also provides the
structure through which the company objectives are set, and the means of
attaining those objectives and monitoring performance” (Source: OECD,
2001).
blocks.text_zh: OECD据此描述了对治理的传统理解：“……指导和控制商业公司的制度。公司治理结构规定公司中不同参与者之间权利与职责的分配，例如董事会、管理者、股东及其他利益相关者，并明确公司事务决策的规则与程序。由此，它也提供设定公司目标、实现目标以及监控绩效的结构。”（来源：OECD，2001年。）

blocks.text_en: 3.1.2.2. Characteristics of Governance

The following characteristics have been adapted from Corporate
Governance (Naidoo, 2002) and are positioned here to highlight both the
value and necessity for governance as an approach to be adopted within
organizations and their dealings with all involved parties:
blocks.text_zh: 以下特征改编自Naidoo（2002年）的《公司治理》，用以突出组织及其与各相关方交往时采用治理的价值与必要性：

blocks.text_en: Discipline
blocks.text_zh: 纪律（Discipline）

blocks.text_en:
All involved parties will have a commitment to adhere to procedures,
processes, and authority structures established by the organization.
blocks.text_zh: 所有相关方承诺遵循组织确立的程序、过程和权限结构。

blocks.text_en: Transparency
blocks.text_zh: 透明度（Transparency）

blocks.text_en:
All actions implemented and their decision support will be available for
inspection by authorized organization and provider parties.
blocks.text_zh: 全部已执行行动及其决策支持信息，均可供获得授权的组织方和供应方检查。

blocks.text_en: Independence
blocks.text_zh: 独立性（Independence）

blocks.text_en:
All processes, decision-making, and mechanisms used will be established
so as to minimize or avoid potential conflicts of interest.
blocks.text_zh: 确立全部过程、决策方式及机制时，应使潜在利益冲突最小化或避免其发生。

blocks.text_en: Accountability
blocks.text_zh: 问责性（Accountability）

blocks.text_en:
Identifiable groups within the organization — e.g., governance boards
who take actions or make decisions — are authorized and accountable for
their actions.
blocks.text_zh: 组织内可识别的群体，例如采取行动或作出决定的治理委员会，应获得授权并对其行动负责。

blocks.text_en: Responsibility
blocks.text_zh: 责任（Responsibility）

blocks.text_en:
Each contracted party is required to act responsibly to the organization
and its stakeholders.
blocks.text_zh: 每个缔约方都必须对组织及其利益相关者负责任地行事。

blocks.text_en: Fairness
blocks.text_zh: 公平性（Fairness）

blocks.text_en:
All decisions taken, processes used, and their implementation will not
be allowed to create unfair advantage to any one particular party.
blocks.text_zh: 所作决定、所用过程及其实施，均不得让某个特定方获得不公平优势。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.3. Technology Governance
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.3. 技术治理

blocks.text_en:
Technology governance controls how an organization utilizes technology
in the research, development, and production of its goods and services.
Although it may include IT governance activities, it often has a broader
scope.
blocks.text_zh: 技术治理控制组织怎样在商品及服务的研究、开发和生产中运用技术。它可能包含IT治理活动，但范围往往更广。

blocks.text_en:
Technology governance is a key capability, requirement, and resource for
most organizations because of the pervasiveness of technology across the
organizational spectrum.
blocks.text_zh: 由于技术遍布组织各方面，技术治理是多数组织的关键能力、要求及资源。

blocks.text_en:
Recent studies have shown that many organizations have a balance in
favor of intangibles rather than tangibles that require management.
Given that most of these intangibles are informational and digital
assets, it is evident that businesses are becoming more reliant on IT:
and the governance of IT — IT governance — is therefore becoming an even
more important part of technology governance.
blocks.text_zh: 近期研究显示，许多组织需要管理的无形资产比有形资产占比更大。多数此类无形资产是信息和数字资产，说明业务愈加依赖IT，因此IT的治理，即IT治理，正成为技术治理中更重要的一部分。

blocks.text_en:
These trends also highlight the dependencies of businesses on not only
the information itself but also the processes, systems, and structures
that create, deliver, and consume it. As the shift to increasing value
through intangibles increases in many industry sectors, so risk
management must be considered as key to understanding and moderating new
challenges, threats, and opportunities.
blocks.text_zh: 这些趋势也凸显：业务不仅依赖信息本身，还依赖创造、交付和消费信息的过程、系统及结构。许多行业日益通过无形资产增加价值，风险管理因而必须被视为理解和调节新挑战、威胁与机会的关键。

blocks.text_en:
Not only are organizations increasingly dependent on IT for their
operations and profitability, but also their reputation, brand, and
ultimately their values are also dependent on that same information and
supporting technology.
blocks.text_zh: 组织日益依赖IT的不只是运营和盈利能力，其声誉、品牌乃至价值观，也依赖同样的信息及支撑技术。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.4. IT Governance
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.4. IT治理

blocks.text_en:
IT governance provides the framework and structure that links IT
resources and information to enterprise goals and strategies.
Furthermore, IT governance institutionalizes best practices for
planning, acquiring, implementing, and monitoring IT performance, to
ensure that the enterprise’s IT assets support its business objectives.
blocks.text_zh: IT治理提供连接IT资源、信息与企业目标及战略的框架和结构。它还把规划、获取、实施及监控IT绩效的最佳实践制度化，以确保企业IT资产支持业务目标。

blocks.text_en:
In recent years, IT governance has become integral to the effective
governance of the modern enterprise. Businesses are increasingly
dependent on IT to support critical business functions and processes;
and to successfully gain competitive advantage, businesses need to
manage effectively the complex technology that is pervasive throughout
the organization in order to respond quickly and safely to business
needs.
blocks.text_zh: 近年来，IT治理已成为现代企业有效治理不可分割的一部分。业务日益依赖IT支持关键职能与流程；要成功获取竞争优势，企业需要有效管理遍布组织的复杂技术，以快速、安全地响应业务需求。

blocks.text_en:
In addition, regulatory environments around the world are increasingly
mandating stricter enterprise control over information, driven by
increasing reports of information system disasters and electronic fraud.
The management of IT-related risk is now widely accepted as a key part
of enterprise governance.
blocks.text_zh: 此外，信息系统灾难与电子欺诈事件的报告增多，推动全球监管环境日益要求企业更严格地控制信息。管理IT相关风险，现已被广泛接受为企业治理的关键部分。

blocks.text_en:
It follows that an IT governance strategy, and an appropriate
organization for implementing the strategy, must be established with the
backing of executive management, clarifying who owns the enterprise’s IT
resources, and, in particular, who has ultimate responsibility for their
enterprise-wide integration.
blocks.text_zh: 因此，必须在高层管理支持下确立IT治理战略及实施该战略的适当组织，明确谁拥有企业IT资源，尤其是谁最终负责其企业范围的集成。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.4.1. An IT Controls Framework — COBIT
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.4.1. IT控制框架——COBIT

blocks.text_en:
As with corporate governance, IT governance is a broad topic, beyond the
scope of an Enterprise Architecture framework such as the TOGAF
framework. A good source of detailed information on IT governance is the
COBIT ® framework (Control OBjectives for Information and related
Technology). This is an open standard for control over IT, developed and
promoted by the IT Governance Institute (ITGI), and published by the
Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA). COBIT controls
may provide useful aides to running a compliance strategy.
blocks.text_zh: 与公司治理一样，IT治理主题广泛，超出TOGAF这类企业架构框架的范围。COBIT框架（Control OBjectives for Information and related Technology，信息及相关技术控制目标）是IT治理详细信息的良好来源。它是用于控制IT的开放标准，由IT治理协会（ITGI）开发和推广，由信息系统审计与控制协会（ISACA）出版。COBIT控制措施可为运行符合性策略提供有用辅助。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.5. Architecture Governance: Overview
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.5. 架构治理概述

blocks.text_en: 3.1.5.1. Architecture Governance Characteristics
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.5.1. 架构治理特征

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Governance is the practice and orientation by which
Enterprise Architectures and other architectures are managed and
controlled at an enterprise-wide level. It includes the following:
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理是在企业范围管理和控制企业架构及其他架构的实践与取向，包括：

blocks.text_en:
Implementing a system of controls over the creation and monitoring of
all architectural components and activities, to ensure the effective
introduction, implementation, and evolution of architectures within the
organization Implementing a system to ensure compliance with internal and external
standards and regulatory obligations Establishing processes that support effective management of the above
processes within agreed parameters Developing practices that ensure accountability to a clearly
identified stakeholder community, both inside and outside the
organization
blocks.text_zh:
- 对所有架构组件和活动的创建及监控实施一套控制机制，确保在组织内有效引入、实施并演进架构。
- 实施一套机制，确保符合内部与外部标准以及监管义务。
- 建立过程，支持在约定参数内有效管理上述过程。
- 发展相应实践，确保向组织内外清楚识别的利益相关者群体承担问责责任。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.5.2. Architecture Governance as a Board-Level Responsibility
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.5.2. 架构治理作为董事会层面的职责

blocks.text_en:
This section aims to provide the impetus for opening up IT and
Architecture Governance so that the business responsibilities associated
with architecture activities and artifacts can be elucidated and
managed.
blocks.text_zh: 本节旨在推动IT与架构治理的开放，使与架构活动及制品有关的业务职责能够得到阐明和管理。

blocks.text_en: 3.1.5.3. The TOGAF Standard and Architecture Governance
blocks.text_zh: 3.1.5.3. TOGAF标准与架构治理

blocks.text_en:
Phase G of the TOGAF ADM (see the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method ) is dedicated to implementation
governance, which concerns itself with the realization of the
architecture through change projects. Implementation governance is just
one aspect of Architecture Governance, which covers the management and
control of all aspects of the development and evolution of Enterprise
Architectures and other architectures within the enterprise.
blocks.text_zh: TOGAF ADM的G阶段（见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》）专门处理实施治理，即通过变革项目实现架构。实施治理只是架构治理的一个方面；架构治理涵盖企业内企业架构及其他架构开发和演进各方面的管理与控制。

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Governance needs to be supported by an Architecture
Governance Framework (described in Section 3.2, “Architecture Governance Framework” ) which assists in identifying effective processes
so that the business responsibilities associated with Architecture
Governance can be elucidated, communicated, and managed effectively.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理需要架构治理框架的支持，见§3.2。该框架辅助识别有效过程，使架构治理相关的业务职责能够得到有效阐明、沟通和管理。

blocks.text_en: 3.2. Architecture Governance Framework
blocks.text_zh: 3.2. 架构治理框架

blocks.text_en:
This section describes a conceptual and organizational framework for
Architecture Governance.
blocks.text_zh: 本节描述架构治理的概念框架和组织框架。

blocks.text_en:
As previously explained, Phase G of the TOGAF ADM (see the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method ) is dedicated to implementation governance, which concerns
itself with the realization of the architecture through change projects.
blocks.text_zh: 如前所述，TOGAF ADM的G阶段（见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》）专门处理实施治理，即通过变革项目实现架构。

blocks.text_en:
Implementation governance is just one aspect of Architecture Governance,
which covers the management and control of all aspects of the
development and evolution of Enterprise Architectures and other
architectures within the enterprise.
blocks.text_zh: 实施治理只是架构治理的一个方面；架构治理涵盖企业内企业架构及其他架构开发和演进各方面的管理与控制。

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Governance needs to be supported by an Architecture
Governance Framework, described below. The governance framework
described is a generic framework that can be adapted to the existing
governance environment of an enterprise. It is intended to assist in
identifying effective processes and organizational structures, so that
the business responsibilities associated with Architecture Governance
can be elucidated, communicated, and managed effectively.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理需要下述架构治理框架的支持。它是可根据企业现有治理环境裁剪的一般框架，旨在辅助识别有效过程与组织结构，使架构治理相关业务职责能够得到有效阐明、沟通和管理。

blocks.text_en: 3.2.1. Architecture Governance Framework — Conceptual Structure
blocks.text_zh: 3.2.1. 架构治理框架——概念结构

blocks.text_en: 3.2.1.1. Key Concepts

Conceptually, Architecture Governance is an approach, a series of
processes, a cultural orientation, and set of owned responsibilities
that ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the organization’s
architectures.
blocks.text_zh: 从概念上说，架构治理是一种方法、一系列过程、一种文化取向，以及一组有明确承担者的职责，共同确保组织架构的完整性和有效性。

blocks.text_en: The key concepts are illustrated in Figure 3-1 .
blocks.text_zh: 关键概念见图3-1。
原图：Architecture Governance Framework — Conceptual Structure

blocks.text_en: Figure 3-1: Architecture Governance Framework — Conceptual Structure
blocks.text_zh: 图3-1：架构治理框架——概念结构

blocks.text_en:
The split of process, content, and context are key to the support of the
Architecture Governance initiative, by allowing the introduction of new
governance material (legal, regulatory, standards-based, or legislative)
without unduly impacting the processes. This content-agnostic approach
ensures that the framework is flexible. The processes are typically
independent of the content and implement a proven best practice approach
to active governance.
blocks.text_zh: 把过程、内容和语境分开，是支持架构治理举措的关键：它允许引入新的治理材料，例如法律、监管、标准或立法材料，而不过度影响过程。这种与内容无关的方法确保框架具有灵活性。过程通常独立于内容，并采用经过验证的最佳实践方法开展主动治理。

blocks.text_en:
The Architecture Governance Framework is integral to the Enterprise
Continuum, and manages all content relevant both to the architecture
itself and to Architecture Governance processes.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理框架是企业连续体不可分割的组成部分，管理与架构本身及架构治理过程有关的全部内容。

blocks.text_en: 3.2.1.2. Key Architecture Governance Processes
blocks.text_zh: 3.2.1.2. 关键架构治理过程

blocks.text_en:
Governance processes are required to identify, manage, audit, and
disseminate all information related to architecture management,
contracts, and implementation. These governance processes will be used
to ensure that all architecture artifacts and contracts, principles, and
Operational-Level Agreements (OLAs) are monitored on an ongoing basis
with clear auditability of all decisions made.
blocks.text_zh: 需要治理过程来识别、管理、审计和传播与架构管理、契约及实施有关的全部信息。这些过程确保持续监控全部架构制品和契约、原则及运营级别协议（OLA），并清楚审计所作的全部决定。

blocks.text_en: Policy Management and Take-On
blocks.text_zh: 政策管理与纳管（Policy Management and Take-On）

blocks.text_en:
All architecture amendments, contracts, and supporting information must
come under governance through a formal process in order to register,
validate, ratify, manage, and publish new or updated content. These
processes will ensure the orderly integration with existing governance
content such that all relevant parties, documents, contracts, and
supporting information are managed and audited.
blocks.text_zh: 全部架构修订、契约及支撑信息必须通过正式过程纳入治理，以登记、验证、确认、管理和发布新增或更新内容。这些过程确保其与既有治理内容有序整合，使所有相关方、文档、契约及支撑信息得到管理和审计。

blocks.text_en: Compliance
blocks.text_zh: 符合性（Compliance）

blocks.text_en:
Compliance assessments against Service-Level Agreements (SLAs), OLAs,
standards, and regulatory requirements will be implemented on an ongoing
basis to ensure stability, conformance, and performance monitoring.
These assessments will be reviewed and either accepted or rejected
depending on the criteria defined within the governance framework.
blocks.text_zh: 应持续按照服务级别协议（SLA）、运营级别协议（OLA）、标准及监管要求进行符合性评估，以确保稳定性、遵循性及绩效监控。评估结果须经过复核，并根据治理框架定义的判据接受或拒绝。

blocks.text_en: Dispensation (also known as Waiver)
blocks.text_zh: 豁免（Dispensation，也称Waiver）

blocks.text_en:
A Compliance Assessment can be rejected where the subject area (design,
operational, service level, or technology) are not compliant. In this
case, the subject area can:
blocks.text_zh: 当所评估领域——设计、运营、服务级别或技术——不符合要求时，可以拒绝该符合性评估。在这种情况下，该领域可以：

blocks.text_en: Be adjusted or realigned in order to meet the compliance requirements Request a dispensation
blocks.text_zh:
1. 调整或重新对齐，以满足符合性要求。
2. 请求豁免。

blocks.text_en:
Where a Compliance Assessment is rejected, an alternate route to meeting
interim conformance is provided through dispensations. These are granted
for a given time period and a set of identified service and operational
criteria that must be enforced during the lifespan of the dispensation.
Dispensations are not granted indefinitely, but are used as a mechanism
to ensure that service levels and operational levels are met while
providing a level of flexibility in their implementation and timing. The
time-bound nature of dispensations ensures that they are a major trigger
in the compliance cycle.
blocks.text_zh: 当符合性评估被拒绝时，可通过豁免提供达到临时遵循要求的替代途径。豁免针对特定期限及一组明确的服务与运营判据授予，这些判据必须在豁免有效期内得到执行。豁免不能无限期授予；其作用是在实施方式和时点上提供一定灵活性，同时确保达到服务级别和运营级别。豁免具有期限，因此成为符合性周期的重要触发因素。

blocks.text_en: Monitoring and Reporting
blocks.text_zh: 监控与报告

blocks.text_en:
Performance management is required to ensure that both the operational
and service elements are managed against an agreed set of criteria. This
will include monitoring against SLAs and OLAs, feedback for adjustment,
and reporting.
blocks.text_zh: 需要绩效管理，确保按约定判据管理运营和服务要素，包括依据SLA和OLA进行监控、为调整提供反馈以及报告。

blocks.text_en: Internal management information will be considered in Environment Management .
blocks.text_zh: 内部管理信息在“环境管理”中考虑。

blocks.text_en: Business Control
blocks.text_zh: 业务控制

blocks.text_en:
Business Control relates to the processes invoked to ensure compliance
with the organization’s business policies.
blocks.text_zh: 业务控制是为确保遵循组织业务政策而启动的过程。

blocks.text_en: Environment Management
blocks.text_zh: 环境管理

blocks.text_en:
This identifies all the services required to ensure that the
repository-based environment underpinning the governance framework is
effective and efficient. This includes the physical and logical
repository management, access, communication, training, and
accreditation of all users.
blocks.text_zh: 环境管理识别确保治理框架所依托的存储库环境有效、高效所需的全部服务，包括物理及逻辑存储库管理、访问、沟通，以及所有用户的培训和认可。

blocks.text_en:
All architecture artifacts, service agreements, contracts, and
supporting information must come under governance through a formal
process in order to register, validate, ratify, manage, and publish new
or updated content. These processes will ensure the orderly integration
with existing governance content such that all relevant parties,
documents, contracts, and supporting information are managed and
audited.
blocks.text_zh: 全部架构制品、服务协议、契约及支撑信息必须通过正式过程纳入治理，以登记、验证、确认、管理和发布新增或更新内容。这些过程确保其与既有治理内容有序整合，使所有相关方、文档、契约及支撑信息得到管理和审计。

blocks.text_en:
The governance environment will have a number of administrative
processes defined in order to effect a managed service and process
environment. These processes will include user management, internal SLAs
(defined in order to control its own processes), and management
information reporting.
blocks.text_zh: 应在治理环境中定义若干管理过程，以实现对服务和过程环境的管理，包括用户管理、为控制自身过程而定义的内部SLA，以及管理信息报告。

blocks.text_en: 3.2.2. Architecture Governance Framework — Organizational Structure
blocks.text_zh: 3.2.2. 架构治理框架——组织结构

blocks.text_en: 3.2.2.1. Overview

Architecture Governance is the practice and orientation by which
Enterprise Architectures and other architectures are managed and
controlled. In order to ensure that this control is effective within the
organization, it is necessary to have the correct organizational
structures established to support all governance activities.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理是管理和控制企业架构及其他架构的实践与取向。要确保这些控制在组织内有效，必须建立正确的组织结构，支持全部治理活动。

blocks.text_en:
An Architecture Governance structure for effectively implementing the
approach described in this section will typically include the following
levels, which may in practice involve a combination of existing IT
governance processes, organizational structures, and capabilities. They
will typically include the following:
blocks.text_zh: 为有效实施本节方法，架构治理结构通常包括以下层次；实际可组合利用已有IT治理过程、组织结构及能力：

blocks.text_en: Global governance board Local governance board Design authorities Working parties
blocks.text_zh:
- 全球治理委员会。
- 本地治理委员会。
- 设计权威机构。
- 工作组。

blocks.text_en:
The architecture organization illustrated in Figure 3-2 highlights the major structural elements required for an Architecture
Governance initiative. While each enterprise will have differing
requirements, it is expected that the basics of the organizational
design shown in Figure 3-2 will be applicable and
implementable in a wide variety of organizational types.
blocks.text_zh: 图3-2中的架构组织突出架构治理举措所需的主要结构要素。各企业要求不同，但预计图示组织设计的基本内容可在多种组织类型中适用和实施。
原图：Architecture Governance Framework — Organizational Structure

blocks.text_en: Figure 3-2: Architecture Governance Framework — Organizational Structure
blocks.text_zh: 图3-2：架构治理框架——组织结构

blocks.text_en: 3.2.2.2. Key Areas

Figure 3-2 identifies three key areas of architecture
management: Develop, Implement, and Deploy. Each of these is the
responsibility of one or more groups within the organization, while the
Enterprise Continuum is shown to support all activities and artifacts
associated with the governance of the architectures throughout their
lifecycle.
blocks.text_zh: 图3-2识别架构管理的三个关键领域：开发（Develop）、实施（Implement）和部署（Deploy）。每个领域由组织中的一个或多个群体负责；企业连续体则支撑架构整个生命周期中与治理相关的全部活动和制品。

blocks.text_en:
The Develop responsibilities, processes, and structures are usually
linked to the TOGAF ADM and its usage, while the Implement
responsibilities, processes, and structures are typically linked to
Phase G (see the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method ).
blocks.text_zh: 开发职责、过程与结构通常联系TOGAF ADM及其使用；实施职责、过程与结构通常联系G阶段，见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》。

blocks.text_en:
As mentioned above, the Architecture Governance Framework is integral to
the Enterprise Continuum, and manages all content relevant both to the
architectures themselves and to Architecture Governance processes.
blocks.text_zh: 如上所述，架构治理框架是企业连续体不可分割的组成部分，管理与架构本身及架构治理过程有关的全部内容。

blocks.text_en: 3.2.2.3. Operational Benefits

As illustrated in Figure 3-2 , the governance of the
organization’s architectures provides not only direct control and guidance of their development and implementation, but also extends into
the operations of the implemented architectures.
blocks.text_zh: 如图3-2所示，对组织架构的治理，不仅直接控制和指导开发与实施，还延伸到已实施架构的运营。

blocks.text_en:
The following benefits have been found to be derived through the
continuing governance of architectures:
blocks.text_zh: 持续治理架构已被发现能带来下列收益：

blocks.text_en:
Links IT processes, resources, and information to organizational
strategies and objectives Integrates and institutionalizes IT best practices Aligns with industry frameworks such as COBIT (planning and
organizing, acquiring and implementing, delivering and supporting, and
monitoring IT performance) Enables the organization to take full advantage of its information,
infrastructure, and hardware and software assets Protects the underlying digital assets of the organization Supports regulatory and best practice requirements such as
auditability, security, responsibility, and accountability Promotes visible risk management
blocks.text_zh:
- 将IT过程、资源和信息与组织战略及目标相连。
- 整合并制度化IT最佳实践。
- 与COBIT等行业框架对齐，包括规划与组织、获取与实施、交付与支持，以及监控IT绩效。
- 使组织充分利用信息、基础设施、硬件和软件资产。
- 保护组织底层数字资产。
- 支持监管与最佳实践要求，如可审计性、安全性、责任和问责性。
- 推动可见的风险管理。

blocks.text_en:
These benefits position the TOGAF Architecture Governance Framework as
an approach, a series of processes, a cultural orientation, and a set of
owned responsibilities, that together ensure the integrity and
effectiveness of the organization’s architectures.
blocks.text_zh: 这些收益表明：TOGAF架构治理框架是一种方法、一系列过程、一种文化取向及一组有明确承担者的职责，共同确保组织架构的完整性和有效性。

blocks.text_en: 3.3. Architecture Governance in Practice
blocks.text_zh: 3.3. 架构治理实践

blocks.text_en:
This section provides practical guidelines for the effective
implementation of Architecture Governance.
blocks.text_zh: 本节提供有效实施架构治理的实用指导。

blocks.text_en: 3.3.1. Architecture Governance — Key Success Factors
blocks.text_zh: 3.3.1. 架构治理的关键成功因素

blocks.text_en:
It is important to consider the following to ensure a successful
approach to Architecture Governance, and to the effective management of
the Architecture Contract:
blocks.text_zh: 要成功开展架构治理并有效管理架构契约，应考虑：

blocks.text_en:
Best practices for the submission, adoption, re-use, reporting, and
retirement of architecture policies, procedures, roles, skills,
organizational structures, and support services Organizational responsibilities and structures to support the
Architecture Governance processes and reporting requirements Integration of tools and processes to facilitate the take-up of the
processes, both procedurally and culturally Criteria for the control of the Architecture Governance processes,
dispensations, compliance assessments, SLAs, and OLAs Internal and external requirements for the effectiveness, efficiency,
confidentiality, integrity, availability, compliance, and reliability of
all Architecture Governance-related information, services, and processes
blocks.text_zh:
- 对架构政策、程序、角色、技能、组织结构和支持服务的提交、采用、复用、报告及退役采用最佳实践。
- 具备支持架构治理过程及报告要求的组织职责和结构。
- 整合工具与过程，从程序及文化两方面促进这些过程的采用。
- 规定控制架构治理过程、豁免、符合性评估、SLA及OLA的判据。
- 识别对全部架构治理相关信息、服务和过程的有效性、效率、保密性、完整性、可用性、符合性及可靠性的内部和外部要求。

blocks.text_en: 3.3.2. Elements of an Effective Architecture Governance Strategy
blocks.text_zh: 3.3.2. 有效架构治理战略的要素

blocks.text_en: 3.3.2.1. Architecture Governance and Corporate Politics
blocks.text_zh: 3.3.2.1. 架构治理与公司政治环境

blocks.text_en:
An Enterprise Architecture imposed without appropriate executive support
and corporate political alignment is bound to fail. In order to succeed,
the Enterprise Architecture must reflect the needs of the organization.
Enterprise Architects, if they are not involved in the development of
business strategy, must at least have a fundamental understanding of it
and of the prevailing business issues facing the organization. It may
even be necessary for them to be involved in the system deployment
process and to ultimately own the investment and product selection
decisions arising from the implementation of the Technology
Architecture.
blocks.text_zh: 缺乏适当高层支持及公司政治环境对齐而强推的企业架构必然失败。要取得成功，企业架构必须反映组织需要。企业架构师若未参与业务战略制定，至少必须从根本上理解该战略及组织当前面对的业务问题。他们甚至可能需要参与系统部署过程，并最终承担技术架构实施所产生的投资和产品选择决定。

blocks.text_en:
There are three important elements of Architecture Governance strategy
that relate particularly to the acceptance and success of architecture
within the enterprise. While relevant and applicable in their own right
apart from their role in governance, and therefore described separately,
they also form an integral part of any effective Architecture Governance
strategy.
blocks.text_zh: 架构治理战略有三个重要要素，尤其关系到架构在企业内的接受与成功。它们本身也有独立意义，因此分别描述，同时构成任何有效架构治理战略不可分割的部分。

blocks.text_en:
A cross-organizational Architecture Board (see Chapter 4, Architecture Board )
must be established
with the backing of executive management to oversee the implementation
of the Enterprise Architecture Governance strategy A comprehensive set of Architecture Principles (see the TOGAF Standard — ADM Techniques )
should be established to guide, inform, and support the way in which an
organization sets about fulfilling its mission through the use of IT An Architecture Compliance strategy (see Chapter 6, Architecture Compliance )
should be adopted — specific
measures (more than just a statement of policy) to ensure compliance
with the architecture, including Project Impact Assessments, a formal
Architecture Compliance review process, and possibly including the
involvement of the architecture team in product procurement
blocks.text_zh:
- 必须在高层管理支持下建立跨组织架构委员会，监督企业架构治理战略的实施，见第4章。
- 应建立完整的一组架构原则，指导、说明并支持组织通过IT完成使命的方式，见《TOGAF标准——ADM技术》。
- 应采用架构符合性策略，见第6章：采取具体措施，而不只是政策声明，确保符合架构，包括项目影响评估、正式架构符合性评审过程，还可能包括架构团队参与产品采购。

blocks.text_en: 4. Architecture Board
blocks.text_zh: 4. 架构委员会

blocks.text_en: This chapter provides guidelines for establishing and operating an Enterprise Architecture Board.
blocks.text_zh: 本章指导如何建立和运行企业架构委员会。

blocks.text_en: 4.1. Role

A key element in a successful Architecture Governance strategy (see Chapter 3, Architecture Governance )
is a cross-organization Architecture Board to oversee the implementation of the strategy. This body should be representative of all the key stakeholders in the architecture, and will typically comprise a group of
executives responsible for the review and maintenance of the overall architecture.
blocks.text_zh: 成功的架构治理战略中，一个关键要素是建立跨组织架构委员会，监督该战略实施，见第3章。该机构应代表架构的所有关键利益相关者，通常由负责复核及维护整体架构的一组高管组成。

blocks.text_en:
Architecture Boards may have global, regional, or business line scope.
Particularly in larger enterprises, Architecture Boards typically
comprise representatives from the organization at a minimum of two
levels:
blocks.text_zh: 架构委员会的范围可以是全球、区域或业务线。尤其在大型企业中，委员会通常至少包含组织内两个层次的代表：

blocks.text_en: Local (domain experts, line responsibility) Global (organization-wide responsibility)
blocks.text_zh:
- 本地层次：领域专家，承担业务线责任。
- 全球层次：承担整个组织的责任。

blocks.text_en:
In such cases, each board will be established with identifiable and
articulated:
blocks.text_zh: 在这些情况下，每个委员会都应有清楚识别及表述的：

blocks.text_en: Responsibilities and decision-making capabilities Remit and authority limits
blocks.text_zh:
- 职责及决策能力。
- 职权范围及权限边界。

blocks.text_en: 4.2. Responsibilities

The Architecture Board is typically made responsible, and accountable,
for achieving some or all of the following goals:
blocks.text_zh: 通常，架构委员会负责并就实现下列部分或全部目标承担问责责任：

blocks.text_en:
Providing the basis for all decision-making with regard to the
architectures Consistency between sub-architectures Establishing targets for re-use of components Flexibility of the Enterprise Architecture: To meet changing business needs To leverage new technologies Enforcement of Architecture Compliance Improving the maturity level of architecture discipline within the
organization Ensuring that the discipline of architecture-based development is
adopted Supporting a visible escalation capability for out-of-bounds decisions
blocks.text_zh:
- 为全部架构相关决策提供基础。
- 保证各子架构之间的一致性。
- 建立组件复用目标。
- 保持企业架构灵活性，以适应变化的业务需要并利用新技术。
- 执行架构符合性要求。
- 提高组织架构纪律的成熟度。
- 确保采用以架构为基础的开发方式。
- 为超出权限范围的决定提供可见的升级处理能力。

blocks.text_en: Further responsibilities from an operational perspective should include:
blocks.text_zh: 从运营角度，还应承担：

blocks.text_en:
All aspects of monitoring and control of the Architecture Contract Meeting on a regular basis Ensuring the effective and consistent management and implementation of
the architectures Resolving ambiguities, issues, or conflicts that have been escalated Providing advice, guidance, and information Ensuring compliance with the architectures, and granting dispensations
that are in keeping with the technology strategy and objectives Considering policy (schedule, SLAs, etc.) changes where similar
dispensations are requested and granted; e.g., new form of service
requirement Ensuring that all information relevant to the implementation of the
Architecture Contract is published under controlled conditions and made
available to authorized parties Validation of reported service levels, cost savings, etc.
blocks.text_zh:
- 对架构契约进行各方面的监控与控制。
- 定期召开会议。
- 确保有效且一致地管理和实施架构。
- 解决上报的歧义、问题和冲突。
- 提供建议、指导和信息。
- 确保符合架构，并授予符合技术战略及目标的豁免。
- 当相似豁免反复被请求并授予时，考虑改变政策，例如排期、SLA或新型服务要求。
- 确保与架构契约实施有关的全部信息在受控条件下发布，并可供授权方获取。
- 验证报告的服务级别、成本节约等。

blocks.text_en:
From a governance perspective, the Architecture Board is also
responsible for:
blocks.text_zh: 从治理角度，架构委员会还负责：

blocks.text_en:
The production of usable governance material and activities Providing a mechanism for the formal acceptance and approval of
architecture through consensus and authorized publication Providing a fundamental control mechanism for ensuring the effective
implementation of the architecture Establishing and maintaining the link between the implementation of
the architecture, the architectural strategy and objectives embodied in
the Enterprise Architecture, and the strategic objectives of the
business Identifying divergence from the architecture and planning activities
for realignment through dispensations or policy updates
blocks.text_zh:
- 产生可用的治理材料与活动。
- 通过共识及授权发布，提供正式接受和批准架构的机制。
- 提供基本控制机制，确保架构有效实施。
- 建立和维护架构实施、企业架构所体现的架构战略与目标、以及业务战略目标之间的联系。
- 识别偏离架构的情况，并通过豁免或政策更新规划重新对齐的活动。

blocks.text_en: 4.3. Setting Up the Architecture Board
blocks.text_zh: 4.3. 建立架构委员会

blocks.text_en: 4.3.1. Enterprise Architecture Sponsorship
blocks.text_zh: 4.3.1. 企业架构发起支持

blocks.text_en:
In many companies, the executive sponsor of the initial architecture
effort is the CIO (or other senior executive). However, to gain broad
corporate support, a sponsoring body has more influence. This sponsoring
body is here called an Architecture Board, but the title is not
important. Whatever the name, it is the executive-level group
responsible for the review and maintenance of the strategic architecture
and all of its sub-architectures.
blocks.text_zh: 在许多公司中，最初架构工作的高层发起人是CIO或其他高管。然而，要获得广泛公司支持，发起机构比个人更有影响力。本文称该机构为“架构委员会”，但名称并不重要；无论如何命名，它都是负责复核和维护战略架构及全部子架构的高层群体。

blocks.text_en:
The Architecture Board is the sponsor of the architecture within the
enterprise, but the Architecture Board itself needs an executive sponsor
from the highest level of the corporation. This commitment must span the
planning process and continue into the maintenance phase of the
architecture project. In many companies that fail in an architecture
planning effort, there is a notable lack of executive participation and
encouragement for the project.
blocks.text_zh: 架构委员会是企业内架构工作的发起支持者，但委员会自身也需要来自公司最高层的高管发起支持。这种承诺必须贯穿规划过程，并延续到架构项目维护阶段。许多架构规划失败的公司，都明显缺乏高层参与及对项目的鼓励。

blocks.text_en:
A frequently overlooked source of Architecture Board members is the
company’s Board of Directors. These individuals invariably have diverse
knowledge about the business and its competition. Because they have a
significant impact on the business vision and objectives, they may be
successful in validating the alignment of IT strategies to business
objectives.
blocks.text_zh: 公司董事会是经常被忽略的架构委员会成员来源。这些成员通常具有关于业务及竞争的多样知识。由于他们显著影响业务愿景和目标，他们可能有效验证IT战略与业务目标的对齐。

blocks.text_en: 4.3.2. Size of the Board
blocks.text_zh: 4.3.2. 委员会规模

blocks.text_en:
The recommended size for an Architecture Board is four or five (and no
more than ten) permanent members. In order to keep the Architecture
Board to a reasonable size, while ensuring enterprise-wide
representation on it over time, membership of the Architecture Board may
be rotated, giving decision-making privileges and responsibilities to
various senior managers. This may be required in any case, due to some
Architecture Board members finding that time constraints prevent
long-term active participation.
blocks.text_zh: 建议架构委员会设四至五名常任成员，不超过十名。为在保持合理规模的同时长期确保企业范围代表性，可以轮换成员，把决策权和责任交给不同高管。部分成员可能因时间限制无法长期积极参与，这本身也可能要求轮换。

blocks.text_en:
An organization may set up its Architecture Board using representational
means, such that each Board member is assigned a set of stakeholders to
represent in the meetings. It is then incumbent upon Board members to
meet with stakeholders to gain their views on the various agenda items.
blocks.text_zh: 组织可采取代表制建立架构委员会，为每位成员分配其在会议上代表的利益相关者。成员因而有责任与这些利益相关者会面，获取他们对议程各项的意见。

blocks.text_en:
However, some continuity must exist on the Architecture Board, to
prevent the corporate architecture from varying from one set of ideas to
another. One technique for ensuring rotation with continuity is to have
set terms for the members, and to have the terms expire at different
times.
blocks.text_zh: 但委员会必须保持一定连续性，避免公司架构从一套理念摇摆到另一套理念。一种兼顾轮换与连续性的方法，是为成员规定任期，并使任期在不同时间到期。

blocks.text_en:
In the ongoing architecture process following the initial architecture
effort, the Architecture Board may be re-chartered. The executive
sponsor will normally review the work of the Architecture Board and
evaluate its effectiveness; if necessary, the Architecture Compliance
review process is updated or changed.
blocks.text_zh: 最初架构工作结束后的持续架构过程中，可以重新规定委员会职权。高层发起人通常复核委员会工作并评价有效性；必要时更新或改变架构符合性评审过程。

blocks.text_en: 4.3.3. Board Structure
blocks.text_zh: 4.3.3. 委员会结构

blocks.text_en:
The TOGAF Architecture Governance Framework (see Section 3.2, “Architecture Governance Framework” )
provides a generic organizational framework that positions the
Architecture Board in the context of the broader governance structures
of the enterprise. This structure identifies the major organizational
groups and responsibilities, as well as the relationship between each
group. This is a best practice structure, and may be subject to change
depending on the organization’s form and existing structures.
blocks.text_zh: TOGAF架构治理框架（§3.2）提供一般组织框架，把架构委员会放在企业更广泛治理结构中定位。该结构识别主要组织群体、职责及群体间关系。它是最佳实践结构，可因组织形式及既有结构而改变。

blocks.text_en:
Consideration must be given to the size of the organization, its form,
and how the IT functions are implemented. This will provide the basis
for designing the Architecture Board structure within the context of the
overall governance environment. In particular, consideration should be
given to the concept of global ownership and local implementation, and
the integration of new concepts and technologies from all areas
implementing against architectures.
blocks.text_zh: 必须考虑组织规模、形式以及IT职能的实施方式，以此为基础，在整体治理环境中设计委员会结构。尤其应考虑全球所有权与本地实施的概念，以及整合来自所有架构实施领域的新概念和新技术。

blocks.text_en:
The structure of the Architecture Board should reflect the form of the
organization. The Architecture Governance structure required may well go
beyond the generic structures outlined in the TOGAF Architecture
Governance Framework; see Section 3.2, “Architecture Governance Framework” .
The organization may need to define a
combination of the IT governance process in place and the existing organizational structures and capabilities, which typically include the following types of body:
blocks.text_zh: 委员会结构应反映组织形式。所需架构治理结构完全可能超出TOGAF架构治理框架（§3.2）的一般结构。组织可能需要结合现有IT治理过程、组织结构及能力，通常包括以下机构类型：

blocks.text_en: Global governance board Local governance board Design authorities Working parties
blocks.text_zh:
- 全球治理委员会。
- 本地治理委员会。
- 设计权威机构。
- 工作组。

blocks.text_en: 4.4. Operation of the Architecture Board
blocks.text_zh: 4.4. 架构委员会的运行

blocks.text_en:
This section describes the operation of the Architecture Board
particularly from the governance perspective.
blocks.text_zh: 本节尤其从治理角度描述架构委员会的运行。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.1. General

Architecture Board meetings should be conducted within clearly identified agendas with explicit objectives, content coverage, and defined actions. In general, board meetings will be aligned with best practice, such as given in the COBIT framework; see Section 3.1.4.1, “An IT Controls Framework — COBIT” .
blocks.text_zh: 委员会会议应有清楚的议程，明确目标、内容范围及规定行动。一般应遵循最佳实践，例如COBIT框架所述实践，见§3.1.4.1。

blocks.text_en: These meetings will provide key direction in:
blocks.text_zh: 这些会议将在以下方面提供关键方向：

blocks.text_en:
Supporting the production of quality governance material and
activities Providing a mechanism for formal acceptance through consensus and
authorized publication Providing a fundamental control mechanism for ensuring the effective
implementation of the architectures Establishing and maintaining the link between the implementation of
the architectures and the stated strategy and objectives of the
organization (business and IT) Identifying divergence from the contract and planning activities to
realign with the contract through dispensations or policy updates
blocks.text_zh:
- 支持产生高质量治理材料与活动。
- 通过共识和授权发布，提供正式接受的机制。
- 提供基本控制机制，确保架构有效实施。
- 建立并维护架构实施与组织既定业务及IT战略和目标之间的联系。
- 识别偏离契约之处，并通过豁免或政策更新规划重新对齐契约的活动。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.2. Preparation

Each participant will receive an agenda and any supporting documentation
— e.g., dispensation requests, performance management reports, etc. —
and will be expected to be familiar with the contents of each.
blocks.text_zh: 每位参与者将收到议程及全部支撑文档，例如豁免请求、绩效管理报告等，并应熟悉其内容。

blocks.text_en:
Where actions have been allocated to an individual, it is that person’s
responsibility to report on progress against these.
blocks.text_zh: 已向个人分配行动时，该个人负责报告行动进展。

blocks.text_en:
Each participant must confirm their availability and attendance at the
Architecture Board meeting.
blocks.text_zh: 每位参与者必须确认能否及是否出席委员会会议。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3. Agenda

This section outlines the contents of an Architecture Board meeting
agenda. Each agenda item is described in terms of its content only.
blocks.text_zh: 本节概述委员会会议议程的内容，仅描述各议程项的内容。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.1. Minutes of Previous Meeting
blocks.text_zh: 4.4.3.1. 前次会议纪要

blocks.text_en:
Minutes contain the details of previous Architecture Board meetings as
per standard organizational protocol.
blocks.text_zh: 纪要按组织标准规程记录以往委员会会议的详情。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.2. Requests for Change

Items under this heading are normally change requests for amendments to
architectures, principles, etc., but may also include business control
with regard to Architecture Contracts; e.g., ensure that voice traffic
to premium numbers, such as weather reports, is barred and data traffic
to certain websites is controlled.
blocks.text_zh: 本项通常是修订架构、原则等的变更请求，也可包含架构契约有关的业务控制，例如确保禁止拨打天气预报等高收费电话号码，并控制访问某些网站的数据流量。

blocks.text_en:
Any request for change is made within agreed authority levels and
parameters defined by the Architecture Contract.
blocks.text_zh: 任何变更请求都应在架构契约定义的约定权限层次及参数内提出。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.3. Dispensations

A dispensation is used as the mechanism to request a change to the
existing architectures, contracts, principles, etc. outside of normal
operating parameters; e.g., exclude provision of service to a
subsidiary, request for unusual service levels for specific business
reasons, deploy non-standard technology or products to support specific
business initiatives.
blocks.text_zh: 豁免是在正常运营参数之外请求改变既有架构、契约、原则等的机制。例如，不向某子公司提供服务；因特定业务原因请求不同寻常的服务级别；部署非标准技术或产品支持某项业务举措。

blocks.text_en:
Dispensations are granted for a given time period and a set of
identified services and operational criteria that must be enforced
during the lifespan of the dispensation. Dispensations are not granted
indefinitely, but are used as a mechanism to ensure that service levels
and operational levels, etc. are met while providing a level flexibility
in their implementation and timing. The time-bound nature of
dispensations ensures that they are a trigger to the Architecture
Compliance activity.
blocks.text_zh: 豁免针对特定期限及一组明确的服务和运营判据授予；这些判据必须在有效期内执行。豁免不能无限期授予，而是在实施方式与时点提供一定灵活性，同时确保达到服务及运营级别等要求。豁免具有期限，因此会触发架构符合性活动。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.4. Compliance Assessments

Compliance is assessed against SLAs, Operational-Level Agreements
(OLAs), cost targets, and required architecture refreshes. These
assessments will be reviewed and either accepted or rejected depending
on the criteria defined within the Architecture Governance Framework.
The Architecture Compliance assessment report will include details as
described.
blocks.text_zh: 依据SLA、运营级别协议（OLA）、成本目标及必要架构更新进行符合性评估。根据治理框架规定的判据，复核后接受或拒绝评估结果。架构符合性评估报告将包含所述详情。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.5. Dispute Resolution

Disputes that have not been resolved through the Architecture Compliance
and dispensation processes are identified here for further action and
are documented through the Architecture Compliance assessments and
dispensation documentation.
blocks.text_zh: 本项识别经过符合性及豁免过程仍未解决、需进一步行动的争议；这些争议记录在符合性评估和豁免文档中。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.6. Architecture Strategy and Direction Documentation
blocks.text_zh: 4.4.3.6. 架构战略与方向文档

blocks.text_en:
This describes the architecture strategies, direction, and priorities
and will only be formulated by the global Architecture Board. It should
take the form of standard architecture documentation.
blocks.text_zh: 本项描述架构战略、方向和优先级，仅由全球架构委员会制定，应采用标准架构文档形式。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.7. Actions Assigned

This is a report on the actions assigned at previous Architecture Board
meetings. An action tracker is used to document and keep the status of
all actions assigned during the Architecture Board meetings and should
consist of at least the following information:
blocks.text_zh: 本项报告以往会议分配的行动。使用行动跟踪器记录和维护所有已分配行动的状态，至少应包含：

blocks.text_en: Reference Priority Action description Action owner Action details Date raised Due date Status Type Resolution date
blocks.text_zh:
- 引用编号。
- 优先级。
- 行动描述。
- 行动责任人。
- 行动详情。
- 提出日期。
- 到期日期。
- 状态。
- 类型。
- 解决日期。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.8. Contract Documentation Management
blocks.text_zh: 4.4.3.8. 契约文档管理

blocks.text_en: This is a formal acceptance of updates and changes to architecture documentation for onward publication.
blocks.text_zh: 本项正式接受架构文档的更新和变化，以便后续发布。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.9. Any Other Business (AOB)
blocks.text_zh: 4.4.3.9. 其他事项（AOB）

blocks.text_en:
Description of issues not directly covered under any of the above. These
may not be described in the agenda but should be raised at the beginning
of the meeting. Any supporting documentation must be managed as per all
Architecture Governance documentation.
blocks.text_zh: 描述上述各项未直接覆盖的问题。可以不在议程中预先描述，但应在会议开始时提出。全部支撑文档必须按照其他架构治理文档的相同方式管理。

blocks.text_en: 4.4.3.10. Schedule of Meetings
All meeting dates should be detailed and published.
blocks.text_zh: 应详细列出并公布全部会议日期。

blocks.text_en: 5. Architecture Contracts
blocks.text_zh: 5. 架构契约

blocks.text_en: This chapter provides guidelines for defining and using Architecture Contracts.
blocks.text_zh: 本章指导如何定义和使用架构契约。

blocks.text_en: 5.1. Role

Architecture Contracts are the joint agreements between development partners and sponsors on the deliverables, quality, and fitness-for-purpose of an architecture. Successful implementation of
these agreements will be delivered through effective Architecture Governance; see Chapter 3, Architecture Governance .
By implementing a governed approach to the management of contracts, the following will be ensured:
blocks.text_zh: 架构契约是开发合作方与发起支持者就架构交付物、质量及适用性达成的共同协议。通过有效架构治理实现这些协议的成功实施，见第3章。对契约管理采用受治理的方法，可确保：

blocks.text_en:
A system of continuous monitoring to check integrity, changes, decision-making, and audit of all architecture-related activities within the organization Adherence to the principles, standards, and requirements of the existing or developing architectures Identification of risks in all aspects of the development and implementation of the architecture(s) covering the internal development against accepted standards, policies, technologies, and products as well
as the operational aspects of the architectures such that the organization can continue its business within a resilient environment A set of processes and practices that ensure accountability, responsibility, and discipline with regard to the development and usage of all architectural artifacts A formal understanding of the governance organization responsible for the contract, their level of authority, and scope of the architecture under the governance of this body
blocks.text_zh:
- 持续监控机制，检查组织内全部架构相关活动的完整性、变化、决策和审计。
- 遵循既有或开发中架构的原则、标准和要求。
- 识别架构开发和实施各方面风险，既包括内部开发对已接受标准、政策、技术和产品的遵循，也包括架构运营方面的风险，使组织能在有韧性的环境中持续开展业务。
- 具备一组过程和实践，确保全部架构制品开发及使用中的问责性、责任和纪律。
- 正式理解负责契约的治理组织、其权限层次，以及该机构治理的架构范围。

blocks.text_en:
The traditional Architecture Contract is an agreement between the sponsor and the architecture function or Information Systems (IS) department. However, increasingly more services are being provided by
systems integrators, applications providers, and service providers, co-ordinated through the architecture function or IS department. There is therefore a need for an Architecture Contract to establish joint agreements between all parties involved in the architecture development and delivery.
blocks.text_zh: 传统架构契约由发起支持者与架构职能或信息系统（IS）部门达成。然而，越来越多服务由系统集成商、应用提供商和服务提供商提供，并由架构职能或IS部门协调。因此，需要架构契约在架构开发和交付的所有参与方之间建立共同协议。

blocks.text_en: Architecture Contracts may occur at various stages of the ADM; for example:
blocks.text_zh: 架构契约可出现在ADM不同阶段，例如：

blocks.text_en:
The Statement of Architecture Work created in Phase A of the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Development Method is effectively an Architecture Contract between the architecting organization and the sponsor of the Enterprise Architecture (or the IT governance function) The development of one or more architecture domains (Business, Data, Application, Technology), and in some cases the oversight of the overall Enterprise Architecture, may be contracted out to systems integrators, applications providers, and/or service providers Each of these arrangements will normally be governed by an Architecture Contract that defines the deliverables, quality, and fitness-for-purpose of the developed architecture, and the processes by which the partners
in the architecture development will work together. At the beginning of Phase G (Implementation Governance), between the architecture function and the function responsible for implementing the Enterprise Architecture defined in the preceding ADM phases; typically, this will be either the in-house systems development function, or a major contractor to whom the work is outsourced What is being “implemented” in Phase G of the ADM is the overall Enterprise Architecture This will typically include the technology infrastructure (from Phase D), and also those enterprise applications and data management capabilities that have been defined in the Application Architecture and Data Architecture (from Phase C), either because they are enterprise-wide in scope, or because they are strategic in business
terms, and therefore of enterprise-wide importance and visibility. However, it will typically not include non-strategic business applications, which business units will subsequently deploy on top of the technology infrastructure that is implemented as part of the
Enterprise Architecture. In larger-scale implementations, there may well be one Architecture Contract per implementation team in a program of implementation projects When the finalized Architecture Definition Document is available (at the end of Phase F), an Architecture Contract will normally be drawn up between the architecting function (or the IT governance function,
subsuming the architecting function) and the business users who will subsequently be building and
deploying systems in the architected environment
blocks.text_zh:
- A阶段产生的架构工作说明（见《TOGAF标准——架构开发方法》），实际上是架构组织与企业架构发起支持者或IT治理职能之间的架构契约。
- 一个或多个领域架构——业务、数据、应用、技术——的开发，有时连同整体企业架构监督，也可以外包给系统集成商、应用提供商和/或服务提供商。每项安排通常由架构契约治理，规定交付物、质量、所开发架构的适用性，以及各合作方的协作过程。
- G阶段（实施治理）开始时，架构职能与负责实施前几个ADM阶段所定义企业架构的职能之间建立契约；实施方通常为内部系统开发职能或承担外包工作的主要承包方。G阶段“实施”的是整体企业架构，通常包括D阶段技术基础设施，以及C阶段应用与数据架构定义的企业应用和数据管理能力；这些能力具有企业范围，或具有战略业务意义，因而对整个企业重要且可见。通常不包括业务单元随后在企业架构所实施技术基础设施之上部署的非战略业务应用。在大型实施中，一个实施项目群可按实施团队分别订立架构契约。
- F阶段结束、最终架构定义文档可用时，架构职能或包含该职能的IT治理职能，通常与随后将在架构环境中构建和部署系统的业务用户订立架构契约。

blocks.text_en:
It is important to bear in mind in all these cases that the ultimate goal is not just an Enterprise Architecture, but a dynamic Enterprise Architecture; i.e., one that allows for flexible evolution in response to changing technology and business drivers, without unnecessary
constraints. The Architecture Contract is crucial to enabling a dynamic Enterprise Architecture and is key to governing the implementation.
blocks.text_zh: 在上述所有情况下，都应牢记最终目标不仅是企业架构，而且是动态企业架构，即可以灵活响应技术与业务驱动变化而演进，避免不必要约束。架构契约对于使能动态企业架构至关重要，也是治理实施的关键。

blocks.text_en: Typical contents of these three kinds of Architecture Contract are explained below.
blocks.text_zh: 下文解释这三类架构契约的典型内容。

blocks.text_en: 5.2. Contents
5.2.1. Statement of Architecture Work
blocks.text_zh: 5.2.1. 架构工作说明

blocks.text_en:
The Statement of Architecture Work is created as a deliverable of Phase A, and is effectively an Architecture Contract between the architecting
organization and the sponsor of the Enterprise Architecture (or the IT governance function, on behalf of the enterprise).
blocks.text_zh: 架构工作说明是A阶段交付物，实际上是架构组织与企业架构发起支持者，或代表企业的IT治理职能之间的架构契约。

blocks.text_en: The typical contents of a Statement of Architecture Work are as defined in the TOGAF Standard — Architecture Content .
blocks.text_zh: 典型内容见《TOGAF标准——架构内容》。

blocks.text_en: 5.2.2. Contract between Architecture Design and Development Partners
blocks.text_zh: 5.2.2. 架构设计与开发合作方之间的契约

blocks.text_en: This is a signed statement of intent on designing and developing the Enterprise Architecture, or significant parts of it, from partner organizations, including systems integrators, applications providers, and service providers.
blocks.text_zh: 这是合作组织——包括系统集成商、应用提供商及服务提供商——就设计和开发企业架构或其中重要部分签署的意向声明。

blocks.text_en:
Increasingly, the development of one or more architecture domains (Business, Data, Application, Technology) may be contracted out, with the enterprise’s architecture function providing oversight of the overall Enterprise Architecture, and co-ordination and control of the
overall effort. In some cases even this oversight role may be contracted out, although most enterprises prefer to retain that core responsibility in-house.
blocks.text_zh: 一个或多个领域架构的开发日益可能外包，由企业架构职能监督整体企业架构，并协调和控制整体工作。有时连监督角色也可能外包，但多数企业倾向于内部保留这一核心责任。

blocks.text_en: Whatever the specifics of the contracting-out arrangements, the arrangements themselves will normally be governed by an Architecture Contract that defines the deliverables, quality, and fitness-for-purpose of the developed architecture, and the processes by which the partners in the architecture development will work together.
blocks.text_zh: 无论外包安排的具体形式如何，通常都由架构契约治理，规定交付物、质量、所开发架构的适用性，以及合作方开展架构开发时共同工作的过程。

blocks.text_en: Typical contents of an Architecture Design and Development Contract are:
blocks.text_zh: 架构设计与开发契约的典型内容包括：

blocks.text_en: Introduction and background The nature of the agreement Scope of the architecture Architecture and strategic principles and requirements Conformance requirements Architecture development and management process and roles Target architecture measures Defined phases of deliverables Prioritized joint workplan Time window(s) Architecture delivery and business metrics
blocks.text_zh:
- 引言与背景。
- 协议性质。
- 架构范围。
- 架构及战略原则与要求。
- 遵循性要求。
- 架构开发及管理过程和角色。
- 目标架构度量。
- 已定义的交付物阶段。
- 按优先级排序的共同工作计划。
- 时间窗口。
- 架构交付及业务度量。

blocks.text_en:
The template for this contract will normally be defined as part of the Preliminary Phase of the ADM, if not existing already, and the specific contract will be defined at the appropriate stage of the ADM, depending
on the particular work that is being contracted out.
blocks.text_zh: 若尚无模板，通常在ADM的Preliminary阶段定义该契约模板；再根据外包工作的性质，在适当ADM阶段定义具体契约。

blocks.text_en: 5.2.3. Contract between Architecting Function and Business Stakeholders
blocks.text_zh: 5.2.3. 架构职能与业务利益相关者之间的契约

blocks.text_en:
When the Implementation and Migration Plan has been agreed (at the end of Phase F), an Architecture Contract may be drawn up between the
architecting function and the business stakeholders
who will subsequently be building and deploying systems in the architected
environment.
blocks.text_zh: 实施与迁移计划在F阶段末达成一致后，可由架构职能与随后在架构环境中构建和部署系统的业务利益相关者订立架构契约。

blocks.text_en: A business stakeholder’s Architecture Contract may include:
blocks.text_zh: 业务利益相关者架构契约可包含：

blocks.text_en: Introduction and background The nature of the agreement Scope Strategic requirements Architecture deliverables that meet the business requirements Conformance requirements Architecture adopters Time window Architecture business metrics SLA
blocks.text_zh:
- 引言与背景。
- 协议性质。
- 范围。
- 战略要求。
- 满足业务需求的架构交付物。
- 遵循性要求。
- 架构采用者。
- 时间窗口。
- 架构业务度量。
- SLA。

blocks.text_en: This contract is also used to manage changes to the Enterprise Architecture in Phase H.
blocks.text_zh: 该契约也用于在H阶段管理企业架构变化。

blocks.text_en: 5.3. Relationship to Architecture Governance
blocks.text_zh: 5.3. 与架构治理的关系

blocks.text_en: The Architecture Contract document produced in Phase G of the ADM figures prominently in the area of Architecture Governance, as explained in Chapter 3, Architecture Governance .
blocks.text_zh: ADM的G阶段产生的架构契约文档，在架构治理中具有突出地位，见第3章。

blocks.text_en: In the context of Architecture Governance, the Architecture Contract is often used as a means of driving architecture change.
blocks.text_zh: 在架构治理语境中，架构契约经常用作驱动架构变化的手段。

blocks.text_en: In order to ensure that the Architecture Contract is effective and efficient, the following aspects of the governance framework may need to be introduced into Phase G:
blocks.text_zh: 要确保架构契约有效、高效，可能需要在G阶段引入治理框架的下列方面：

blocks.text_en: Simple processes People-centered authority Strong communication Timely responses and an effective escalation process Supporting organizational structures Status tracking of architecture implementation
blocks.text_zh:
- 简单的过程。
- 以人为中心的权威。
- 有力的沟通。
- 及时响应及有效升级处理过程。
- 支撑性组织结构。
- 架构实施状态跟踪。

blocks.text_en: 6. Architecture Compliance
blocks.text_zh: 6. 架构符合性

blocks.text_en:
This chapter provides guidelines for ensuring project compliance to the
architecture.
blocks.text_zh: 本章指导如何确保项目符合架构。

blocks.text_en: 6.1. Introduction

Ensuring the compliance of individual projects with the Enterprise Architecture is an essential aspect of Architecture Governance; see Chapter 3, Architecture Governance .
To this end, the IT governance function within an enterprise will normally define two complementary processes:
blocks.text_zh: 确保各项目符合企业架构，是架构治理的重要方面，见第3章。为此，企业IT治理职能通常定义两个互补过程：

blocks.text_en: The Architecture function will be required to prepare a series of Project Architectures; i.e., project-specific views of the Enterprise Architecture that illustrate how the Enterprise Architecture impacts on the major projects within the organization (see ADM Phases A to F) The Enterprise and IT Governance functions will define a formal Architecture Compliance review process (see Section 6.3, “Architecture Compliance Reviews” ) for reviewing the compliance of all projects to the Enterprise Architecture
blocks.text_zh:
- 要求架构职能准备一系列项目架构，即企业架构针对项目的视图，说明企业架构如何影响组织中的主要项目，见ADM的A至F阶段。
- 企业治理及IT治理职能定义正式架构符合性评审过程，评审所有项目是否符合企业架构，见§6.3。

blocks.text_en:
Apart from defining formal processes, the Architecture Governance function (see Chapter 3, Architecture Governance )
may also stipulate that the architecture function should extend beyond the role of architecture definition and standards selection, and participate also in the technology selection process, and even in the commercial
relationships involved in external service provision and product purchases. This may help to minimize the opportunity for misinterpretation of the Enterprise Architecture, and maximize the value of centralized commercial negotiation.
blocks.text_zh: 除定义正式过程外，架构治理职能还可能规定：架构职能不应只定义架构和选择标准，还应参与技术选择，乃至参与外部服务和产品采购的商业关系。这有助于减少误解企业架构的机会，并最大化集中商业谈判的价值。

blocks.text_en: 6.2. Terminology: The Meaning of Architecture Compliance
blocks.text_zh: 6.2. 术语：架构符合性的含义

blocks.text_en:
A key relationship between the architecture and the implementation lies in the definitions of the terms “conformant”, “compliant”, etc. While terminology usage may differ between organizations, the concepts of
levels of conformance illustrated in Figure 6-1 should prove useful in formulating an IT compliance strategy.
blocks.text_zh: 架构与实施之间的关键关系之一，在于“conformant”“compliant”等术语的定义。不同组织用语可能不同，但图6-1所示的遵循程度概念，有助于制定IT符合性策略。
原图：Levels of Architecture Conformance

blocks.text_en: Figure 6-1: Levels of Architecture Conformance
blocks.text_zh: 图6-1：架构遵循程度（Levels of Architecture Conformance）

blocks.text_en: The phrase “in accordance with” in Figure 6-1 means:
blocks.text_zh: 图6-1中的“in accordance with”（与之相符）表示：

blocks.text_en:
Supports the stated strategy and future directions Adheres to the stated standards (including syntax and semantic rules
specified) Provides the stated functionality Adheres to the stated principles; for example: Open wherever possible and appropriate Re-use of component building blocks wherever possible and appropriate
blocks.text_zh:
- 支持既定战略及未来方向。
- 遵循既定标准，包括规定的语法与语义规则。
- 提供既定功能。
- 遵循既定原则，例如：在可能且适当时采用开放方式；在可能且适当时复用组件构建块。

blocks.text_en: 6.3. Architecture Compliance Reviews
blocks.text_zh: 6.3. 架构符合性评审

blocks.text_en:
An Architecture Compliance review is a scrutiny of the compliance of a
specific project against established architectural criteria, spirit, and
business objectives. A formal process for such reviews normally forms
the core of an Enterprise Architecture Compliance strategy.
blocks.text_zh: 架构符合性评审，是根据已确立的架构判据、精神和业务目标，对具体项目符合性进行的仔细审查。此类正式评审过程通常构成企业架构符合性策略的核心。

blocks.text_en: 6.3.1. Purpose

The goals of an Architecture Compliance review include some or all of
the following:
blocks.text_zh: 架构符合性评审目标包括下列部分或全部内容：

blocks.text_en:
First and foremost, catch errors in the project architecture early, and thereby reduce the cost and risk of changes required later in the lifecycle This in turn means that the overall project time is shortened, and that the business gets the bottom-line benefit of the architecture development faster.
